grades_select_school_members.name: grades_select_school_members
grades_select_school_members.using:
exists (
    select 1 from user_roles ur
    where ur.user_id = (select auth.uid()) and ur.school_id = grades.school_id
  )

streams_select_school_members.name: streams_select_school_members
streams_select_school_members.using:
exists (
    select 1 from grades g
    join user_roles ur on ur.school_id = g.school_id
    where g.id = streams.grade_id and ur.user_id = (select auth.uid())
  )
